manual_reference: 1.5 Attribute Analysis (1.5.1a Bright Spot workflow — Energy attribute on F3 Demo seismic)
goal: F3 Demo survey에서 매뉴얼 1.5.1a 절차에 따라 Bright Spot 탐지를 위한 Energy attribute를 계산한다. 중요 규칙: 화면에 실제로 보이는 버튼/메뉴 이름 그대로만 지시할 것. 존재하지 않는 이름을 만들어내지 말 것. 워크플로우: 먼저 상단 메뉴 바에서 'Attribute'를 클릭하여 드롭다운을 연다. 그 안의 '3D' 서브메뉴로 이동하여 'Define...' 항목을 선택한다 (이렇게 하면 Attribute Set 편집 창이 열린다). 그 창에서 왼쪽 목록의 'Energy'를 선택하고, 이름 필드에 'Energy_16ms' 등을 입력하고, Time Gate와 Input Data를 채운 뒤 'Add as new' 버튼으로 attribute set에 추가한다. 이어서 툴바의 볼륨 계산 아이콘(초록색 러닝맨/화살표)을 눌러 처리 다이얼로그를 열고, 볼륨 범위를 확인한 뒤 'OK' 또는 'Proceed'로 실행한다. 처리 완료 후 Tree scene의 In-line 카테고리 아래의 In-line 자식을 우클릭하여 컨텍스트 메뉴에서 'Add > Attribute > Stored...' 또는 'Add' 항목으로 방금 만든 Energy_16ms를 In-line에 표시한다.

initial_state.description: F3 Demo survey 로드된 상태. Main Window 열려있고 Tree scene에 seismic cube가 이미 추가되어 있음 (In-line 하위에 자식 노드 존재). 어떤 wizard/dialog도 안 열려있고 Attribute Set dialog도 안 열려있음.
must_be_true: OpendTect Main Window is loaded with F3 Demo (or similar seismic-loaded) survey active
Seismic cube exists in Tree scene under Elements/Volume or already displayed as In-line
No Attribute Set / Attribute Engine dialog open yet

visible_elements: Main menu bar (Survey, Analysis, Processing, Scene, View, Utilities, Help)
visual_state_gt.data_state: F3 Demo loaded, seismic cube available, no attribute set yet
visual_state_gt.current_action: user needs to open the Attribute Set / Attribute Engine dialog

allowed_alternatives.note: Some manual paths use Utilities menu

capture_instructions.screen_state: OpendTect Main Window with F3 Demo loaded. Seismic already visible in 3D Scene (or as In-line child). No dialog is open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Opened OpendTect, loaded F3 Demo survey, and has seismic ready — has NOT yet started Attribute workflow.

visual_state_gt.data_state: Attribute Set dialog just opened, no attribute type chosen yet
visual_state_gt.current_action: user must select the Energy attribute type

allowed_alternatives.note: Model may mention the dropdown/list as the immediate target

capture_instructions.screen_state: Attribute Set / Attribute Engine dialog has just opened. Attribute type field or dropdown is visible but Energy is not yet selected.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Opened the Attribute Set dialog via the menu (Analysis > Attributes > 3D Attributes, or similar).
must_not_show: Energy already selected and parameters already filled

visible_elements: Time gate min/max fields (empty or defaults)
visual_state_gt.data_state: Energy attribute type selected; name and parameters not yet filled
visual_state_gt.current_action: user must enter an attribute name (e.g. Energy_10ms)

capture_instructions.screen_state: Attribute Set dialog with Energy selected. Attribute name field is visible and empty.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Selected the Energy attribute type from the dropdown/list.

visible_elements: Attribute name field with user-typed value (e.g. Energy_10ms)
visual_state_gt.data_state: Energy attribute type + name set; time gate defaults or already customized
visual_state_gt.current_action: user must add this attribute to the set (Add / Add as new)

capture_instructions.screen_state: Attribute Set with attribute name filled in (e.g. Energy_10ms) and time gate values entered.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Typed the attribute name and (optionally) adjusted the time gate.
must_not_show: Attribute already added to the list (would show it in the attribute set table)

visual_state_gt.data_state: Attribute added; a sub-selection or positioning dialog now requests ranges before processing
visual_state_gt.current_action: user must confirm the sub-selection ranges and launch processing

allowed_alternatives.note: Model may reference the ranges themselves

capture_instructions.screen_state: Sub-selection / positioning dialog is open (either directly after Add, or after clicking 'Proceed' / 'Run'). Range fields visible.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Added the attribute to the set and clicked a button that opened the positioning / sub-selection dialog.
must_not_show: Attribute already displayed on In-line (that's after processing)
Attribute Set main dialog still on top

visual_state_gt.current_dialog: OpendTect Main Window (attribute result available) or Attribute display context
visible_elements: 3D Scene with in-line / seismic display visible
Tree scene now includes the newly computed Energy attribute (or attribute displayed on In-line)
Attribute name (e.g. Energy_10ms) visible in Elements
Right-click / Add Attribute option on In-line
visual_state_gt.data_state: Processing done. Attribute available; user must display it on In-line or 3D Scene.
visual_state_gt.current_action: user must add the computed attribute to the In-line display (right-click In-line or use scene menu)

allowed_alternatives.note: Model may reference the attribute by name

trap.description: For the display step, the right-click target must be the In-line CATEGORY node OR the existing In-line child (to add the attribute to it), not the Elements group or the Volume group.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Processing finished, Main Window in focus again. New attribute (e.g. Energy_10ms) exists in the project. In-line is visible but the attribute is not yet displayed on it.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Waited for the attribute processing to finish (progress bar hits 100 % and closes).
must_not_show: Attribute already displayed on In-line (that's the completion state after step_5's action)

completion.note: After step 5's action executes, the Energy attribute should be visible on the In-line in the 3D Scene. The next /step call should trigger the model to emit '완료'. That final capture may become step_6 if it fires.
